Phishing site detection
Detect and mark reported phishing sites with warnings. When
this setting is enabled, URLs contained in messages will be sent
to our server for the detection of phishing sites.
Note: This setting can only be enabled if the "URL previews" is
turned on.
Add events to calendar from messages
Dates and times included in messages will be shown as links
which you can tap to add them to your calendar.
